body:
Execution handoff (within saved scope, no revision): Main will pair two implementation slices. Primary owns new main/kanban/approveLearningCard.ts + tests (createLearningApprovalController). Secondary owns desktop IPC/preload/sharedDmApi/FakeDm, WorkspacePool/bootstrap/sharedGitRunner+OperationLocks and narrow untrack/quit lifecycle seams/tests.
Proposed controller port: approve(workspace, exact CommandInput<prepareLearningApproval>) -> final KanbanCardView; recover(workspace) -> Promise<void>; status(workspace,cardId) -> local pending LearningApprovalView|null; drain(folder?) -> Promise<void> synchronously marks closing/aborts then awaits whole owned work; busy() -> boolean. Dependencies one shared GitRunner/OperationLocks, trusted registered owned-worktree provider, background error callback. Narrow APIs approveLearningCard(folder,reviewedInput) and getLearningApprovalStatus(folder,cardId), typed CommandResult; ordinary generic approval unchanged/fail-closed for generated cards. Reuse existing CommandInput/Output aliases, no duplicated DTO convention. Workers may propose evidenced refinements to Main before edits.
Startup enumerates existing local pending ONLY; never prepare/re-authorize Ready cards. Real persist callback current-validates even replay before canonical mutation; derive sources/repository registry from current canonical learningBranchPlans + bound source/submission, not engine JSON paths. Native recovery receives untrusted durable plan under current trusted registry and existing native live-ownership validation. Shared locks also used by Source control. WorkspacePool onOpen only after caching. Old-workspace late jobs remain closed, newly opened instance may recover; global shutdown permanent.
Untrack/quit synchronously quiesce/cancel and await actual native onExit/whole-flow drain before pool/SQLite close. Existing5s chat timeout must NOT race away native drain or increase. Minimal distinct native-before-release barrier; migrate all required dependency callers, no fallback lock convention. FolderRegistry canonical stored roots plus fresh availability/realpath identity supply ownership, never renderer/engine JSON. Targeted saved tests + isolated actual Electron main/preload path proof; no full sweep before719.
